inlines.v: WICKEDNESS, noun Departure from the rules of the divine law; evil disposition or practices; immorality; crime; sin; sinfulness; corrupt manners wickedness generally signifies evil practices. What wickedness is this that is done among you? Judges 20:3. But wickedness expresses also the corrupt dispositions of the heart. Their inward part is very wickedness Psalms 5:4. In heart ye work wickedness Psalms 5:48.
